description: A dark, polished wooden writing desk inside a ship's cabin, with a round brass porthole on the left showing grey choppy sea under a cloudy sky. On the desk sit a tall stack of handwritten pages with a pair of round spectacles resting on top, a glass inkwell with a quill pen, crumpled paper balls, a loose letter with a small emblem at top right, and a fountain pen. There are no people. The scene is lit by a brass wall lamp at upper right and looks like an oil painting.
